recipe.visualDefinition: A studio-lit ensemble portrait featuring four distinct characters in costume posed around a bright yellow subcompact car. The scene is set against a clean white background with a soft vignette, topped by heavy, distorted display typography that mimics water refraction.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters interacting physically with the central yellow vehicle
High-contrast white spotlight against a dark upper border
Textual distortion reflecting the thematic 'drowning' concept
Vibrant primary yellow car anchoring the desaturated character palette
coreInvariants: Bright yellow subcompact car as the central prop
Horizontal character alignment across the mid-ground
Water-ripple distortion on the primary title text
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four characters are distributed across the horizontal axis, scaled to fit within the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow car serves as the primary visual anchor in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold white title at the top, moves down to the central car, and then scans left-to-right across the character archetypes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space around the subjects creates a 'floating' studio effect, contrasted by the black header.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light gray provide the neutral studio backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black header creates a sharp top-down contrast for the title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid yellow (car and one character's dress) acts as the primary focal color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation yellow pops against the low-saturation clothing of other characters and the white floor.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block weights with minimal tracking
Horizontal wave-like distortion applied to the lower half of the glyphs
Sharp, clean edges on the top half of the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The bottom edges of all letters in the main title are jagged to simulate water ripples.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distorted display face paired with a clean, small-scale geometric sans for secondary info.

preserve: The ripple distortion on the main title
The yellow-on-black color scheme for metadata
avoid: Thin weights for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky weight for the ripple distortion.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio shot of a bright yellow 1980s subcompact car on a white floor. Surround the car with four characters: a woman in a puffy white wedding dress, a woman in a denim shirt sitting on the roof, a man in a grey security guard uniform standing in front, and a woman in a yellow waitress uniform sitting on the trunk. The top of the frame should fade into a black vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line centered title in extra-bold white sans-serif. Apply a horizontal 'liquid ripple' or 'water wave' distortion filter to the bottom half of the letters. Add a single line of small yellow bold sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the main title white with a ripple effect?
Is there a black vignette at the top?
Are the characters posed around the car on a white background?

adjustableVariables: Specific car model (must remain a yellow subcompact)

mustAchieve: Clear color contrast between yellow and white/black

postGenerationChecks: Typography distortion is horizontal and wave-like
Yellow car is the central focal point
Top text is yellow and centered
Background is a clean white studio floor
Characters do not overlap the main title
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio ensemble + central color-pop prop + top-down vignette + liquid-distorted bold typography.
